title: Counit images of the two integral comparison composites
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ for $m\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Z\xrightarrow h W\xrightarrow k V$ be isomorphisms of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with small pro-etale sites, completed sheaves $R_T=\lim_m(A_{E,m})_T$ and their module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $N\in D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], choose the flat-term K-flat resolution $q:P\to N$ used for completed pullback [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Put $P_m=P\otimes_{R_V}(A_{E,m})_V$. For $g=k,kh$ put $C_{g,m}=\operatorname{Res}_m g_m^*P_m$ with actual quotient transitions; let $\theta_g^\Delta:\Delta g^{-1}P\to C_{g,\bullet}$ be the strict map with components $x\mapsto\bar x\otimes1$ [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Here $g^{-1}$ has its module action transported through the specified completed coefficient isomorphism, and $\Delta$ is the termwise constant-tower functor [def-weil-inverse-system]. Set $M=Lk^*N=R\lim C_{k,\bullet}$, $D_\bullet=h^*C_{k,\bullet}$, and $X=h^{-1}k^{-1}N$.
Let $d_P:h^{-1}k^{-1}P\xrightarrow\sim(kh)^{-1}P$ and $d_N$ be the canonical inverse-image compositors [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $c_\bullet:C_{kh,\bullet}\xrightarrow\sim D_\bullet$ have components the canonical finite module pullback compositors $(kh)^*P_m\xrightarrow\sim h^*k^*P_m$ [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Let $u_{h,C_k}:h^{-1}C_{k,\bullet}\to D_\bullet$ have components $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ [def-trf-integral-tower-inverse-image-unit]. Let $\eta:Lh^*M\xrightarrow\sim R\lim D_\bullet$ and $c^E:L(kh)^*N\xrightarrow\sim Lh^*M$ be exactly the normalized comparisons of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], so $\eta c^E=R\lim(c_\bullet)$. Use the specified $\kappa$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and its normalized Roos identification with total derived limit. For each strict tower $T$, $\epsilon_T:\Delta R\lim T\to T$ is the whole-tower counit computed on a K-injective tower resolution by the ordinary limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Define
$$a=\eta\circ c^E\circ\kappa^{kh}_N\circ d_N,\qquad b=\eta\circ\kappa^h_M\circ h^{-1}(\kappa^k_N),\qquad Q=h^{-1}k^{-1}(q).$$
Then the following two identities hold in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R_Z)))$, both with source $\Delta X$ and target $D_\bullet$:
$$\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(a)=c_\bullet\circ\theta_{kh}^\Delta\circ\Delta(d_P)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1},$$
$$\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(b)=u_{h,C_k}\circ h^{-1}(\theta_k^\Delta)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1}.$$
The canonical commutation of exact termwise $h^{-1}$ with $\Delta$ is implicit. These are formulas for entire strict tower morphisms, retaining the common resolution denominator; they assert neither equality of $a,b$ nor faithfulness of separate derived evaluations.
